# Copilot / AI Agent Instructions

This repository is agent-agnostic. Before making changes, read:
1. `projects/PROJECT_SYSTEM_BASE.md`
2. `AGENTS.md`
3. `PROJECT_MAP.md`

If working on a specific project (`projects/<project-id>`), read **all** `.md` files in `projects/<project-id>/skills/` first. Projects are fully isolated (`project.json`, `fonts/`, `skills/`, `pages/`). Keep output compatible with valid PDF preview/export.
